displayName: [Preview]: Azure AI Services RAI egress headers should use safe operations, references, and HTTPS
description: Require safe header operations, reference-based header values, valid secret or managed identity references, and HTTPS for credential-bearing RAI egress rewrites. Does not validate runtime mode or network destination restrictions.

metadata.description: Audit, deny, or disable these authoring checks. Does not change runtime egress mode.
